# Clinical Quality

This folder holds research and data on how clinical quality is measured and maintained in acute surgical care across Denmark. It focuses on the metrics used by the Akut Kirurgi Databasen to track postoperative monitoring for vulnerable, high-risk patients and to calculate 30-day and 90-day mortality rates. These indicators provide a foundational framework for evaluating surgical outcomes and ensuring that high-risk populations receive appropriate intermediate care.

## Pages

- [[clinical-quality|Clinical Quality]] — Details the evaluation of postoperative care standards and patient survival outcomes in acute surgical care, focusing on specific metrics like the monitoring of high-risk patients and 30-day and 90-day mortality rates.
